page.overview:
Who is Machine Head's Crew?

Isotope (#2 to the current boss) Kursk Tether Tyrant Magmaniac Furnace Battle Beast (temporary ally, not really an actual member)

Machine Head's Crew was a group of semi powerful supervillains under the helm of Machine Head.

Isotope summoned Battle Beast, Tether Tyrant, Furnace, Magmaniac and Kursk when Invincible and Titan appeared to take down Machine Head. After defeating them, the Guardians arrived and were able to defeat some of them, however when both Monster Girl and Black Samson were brutalized, Robot led the Guardians to a brave stand and defeated three of them, while Battle Beast left, finding distaste in his fight and left to parts unknown. Machine Head, along with the others, were arrested by the G.D.A..
